decision.rationale: Official Faculty of Applied Science joint UNBC/UBC Environmental Engineering program, explicitly serving UBC Vancouver. The public homepage provides program information and observed sections for academic requirements, student support, experiential opportunities, news and alumni stories. No distinct research section is evidenced.

rules.rationale: Homepage Alumni Spotlights links identify graduate experience narratives.
Homepage navigation identifies a dedicated News section under Student Experience.
Student Associations, Coordinated International Experience and Co-operative Education describe participation and experiential opportunities.
Student Resources, Transit and Contact Us provide practical student help rather than curriculum descriptions.
Program Guide, Course Registration, Future Students and Graduation concern degree requirements, admissions and academic progression.
